notes: «قال سألت سليمان بن يسار»: عمرو is the asker and سليمان the one asked who answers, so سليمان is a link in his own place
the saying ends at عائشة, a Companion; the Prophet is not written
the archive flag names a further transmitter after the last stored name; the text's last transmitter is عائشة, which the stored chain does not carry
